non_blocking_findings.text: Interpreter run V17 (609 s) ignored its perl alarm 500; the doc says so honestly. The 6.7x ratio rests on a single interpreter run (VM runs x3); not re-run by me (too long).

The 'ordinary reply 17.0-17.4 ms diff/encode' and 'comb diff/encode 17.6-18.1' come from serve minus tick means (V16); I could only confirm serve/tick directly for the decision tick (see re-ran). The subtraction is two instruments' means, and the 22%/78% shares inherit that.

The 'rest ~43.3-43.8 ms, 54%' is explicitly not decomposed (Go pprof cannot name AILANG functions); the doc says so, but the Verdict still reads as if the step is understood. O4 alone is correctly stated as not predicted to remove the comb (44+18 = 62 ms > 50 ms).

Off-cadence bursts (h4 394-402, h5 595-604) are attributed to 'host scheduling or the sim runtime, e.g. GC', labelled UNMEASURED. Correct label; I confirmed in h4.lat/h5.lat that they exist and are absent from V16 replay (16-21 ms). It means the p99 tail has a second, unexplained component that O4 and the comb analysis do not address; the doc should perhaps state that in OQ3 more prominently.

Tap-clock tick labels differ from Godot-side by 2 (lat file 408/462/515/568/622 vs doc's 406/460/513/566/620). The doc states 'reply n is tick n-2' in V14 only; easy to misread when cross-checking the raw .lat files.

upstream_draft_verdict: Fit to send after small edits. Repro /tmp/stap108/repro/sortedjson.ail is standalone, no packages, and shows what the draft claims: I ran it on v0.56.1 VM, n=12 reps=2000 per-compare 75 and 68 ms vs keyed 26 and 27 ms; n=40 reps=500 98 vs 28 ms; same_output true. The recipient is right (package maintainers via inbox user, not a VM-vs-interpreter bug; draft says so). Edits wanted: (1) the repro shows only a 2.5-3.5x pattern cost, so the title's 'a third of ~64 ms' is the game's number, not the repro's; say that the repro demonstrates the pattern and the 20.5 ms comes from the byte-identical ablation. (2) State that the repro emits a MOD010 temp-path warning (harmless) or move the module name to 'sortedjson'. (3) The draft says Hot spot 2 releaseFrame/memclr 14.3% 'not specific to this path'; fine, but the V24 negative (frame-pool hypothesis not reproduced) is correctly omitted. (4) Attach the repro file and bundle URL as it says; the draft's 'sha256 in the doc' is OK. (5) It cites crew_auto.ail cadenceLongSkip: verified at sim/crew_auto.ail:34. No claim overreaches.
